(def underive
  "Removes a parent/child relationship between parent and
  tag. h must be a hierarchy obtained from make-hierarchy, if not
  supplied defaults to, and modifies, the global hierarchy."
  (fn
    ([tag parent]
     (swap-global-hierarchy! underive tag parent)
     nil)
    ([h tag parent]
     (let [parentMap (:parents h)
           childsParents (if (parentMap tag)
                           (disj (parentMap tag) parent) #{})
           newParents (if (not-empty childsParents)
                        (assoc parentMap tag childsParents)
                        (dissoc parentMap tag))
           deriv-seq (flatten (map (fn [e] (cons (key e) (interpose (key e) (val e))))
                                   (seq newParents)))]
       (if (contains? (parentMap tag) parent)
         (reduce (fn [h pair] (apply derive h pair)) (make-hierarchy)
                 (partition 2 deriv-seq))
         h)))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). Follows Clojure, which reads each parents entry with key and val.
